install: if ((Get-FileHash "$env:TEMP/windows-terminal.zip" -Algorithm SHA256).Hash -ne '273d6f1502eca1b5bd95c43f5d4d7ec72cc503df340102f8659717e5bead3437') { throw 'The Windows Terminal ZIP does not match its pinned sha256.' }
apply: $n = @{}; foreach ($v in 'day', 'night') { $n[$v] = (Get-Content "$env:INGLENOOK_PORT/dist/$v/themes-$v.json" -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json).themes[0].name }; $s = [ordered]@{ themes = @(foreach ($v in 'day', 'night') { (Get-Content "$env:INGLENOOK_PORT/dist/$v/themes-$v.json" -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json).themes }); theme = [ordered]@{ dark = $n.night; light = $n.day }; profiles = [ordered]@{ defaults = [ordered]@{ colorScheme = [ordered]@{ dark = $n.night; light = $n.day }; intenseTextStyle = 'bold'; font = [ordered]@{ face = 'BlexMono Nerd Font Mono' } } } }; $s | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8 | Set-Content "$env:LOCALAPPDATA/Microsoft/Windows Terminal/settings.json"
stage: $s = Get-Content "$env:LOCALAPPDATA/Microsoft/Windows Terminal/settings.json" -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json -AsHashtable; $s.showAdminShield = $false; $s.initialCols = 110; $s.initialRows = 30; $s | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8 | Set-Content "$env:LOCALAPPDATA/Microsoft/Windows Terminal/settings.json"
